coco-woods.title: Coco Woods
coco-woods.subtitle: Creamy Woody Extrait
coco-woods.headline: Vanilla, in a deeper state.
coco-woods.pullquote: Soft, but defined. Warm, but never overwhelming.
coco-woods.summary: A softer kind of depth. Vanilla, wrapped in coconut, musk… and everything in between.
alts: Coco Woods on a raw wooden plinth against warm cream, with three circular ingredient thumbnails — coconut, vanilla pods, wood chips — joined by gold leader lines to the top, middle and base notes
Coco Woods Extrait de Parfum standing on a warm neutral ground
Coco Woods in a warm neutral still life with cream and raw wood tones
Second frame of the Coco Woods still life

mawj.title: Mawj
mawj.subtitle: Aquatic Woody Extrait
mawj.headline: Where the sea is always moving.
mawj.pullquote: Not all waves are meant to be chased. Some are meant to be worn.
mawj.summary: An elegant aquatic perfume reflects the depth of the sea & its fresh breeze in an oriental way.
alts: Mawj Extrait de Parfum standing on a white salt ledge against a deep navy sea horizon and pale blue sky
A hand with a steel bracelet lifting the Mawj bottle out of shallow sea water, water streaming from the base
Mawj bottle photographed on an aquatic set, front three-quarter view
Second angle of the Mawj bottle on the same aquatic set
Mawj bottle on the salt ledge, second frame from the sea location shoot
Companion frame from the sea-water session showing the Mawj bottle held above the surface

pink-allure.title: Pink Allure
pink-allure.subtitle: Powdery Floral Musk Extrait
pink-allure.headline: The kind of femininity that doesn't ask for attention.
pink-allure.pullquote: The kind of femininity that doesn't ask for attention. Yet somehow gets it anyway.
pink-allure.summary: A presence defined by softness. Calm, polished, and effortlessly composed. The kind of aura that feels gentle, yet leaves a lasting impression.
alts: Pink Allure bottle lying on rippling blush-pink satin, curved glass refracting across the black label
Pink Allure sharp in the foreground with Pink Arrogance soft-focus behind it on a pale blush ground
Pink Allure bottle against a blush background, label lockup fully legible
Extreme close crop of the Pink Allure bottle — glass and blush liquid abstraction
Third angle of Pink Allure on the blush liquid set
Reverse framing of the Pink Allure and Pink Arrogance pair

tobacco-vanilla.title: Tobacco Vanilla
tobacco-vanilla.subtitle: Smoky Gourmand Extrait
tobacco-vanilla.headline: It speaks of low amber light, and long autumn nights.
tobacco-vanilla.pullquote: A fragrance that doesn't just linger in the air, but in the memories it creates.
tobacco-vanilla.summary: A deep tobacco-vanilla scent defined by warmth, stillness, and quiet intensity.
alts: Tobacco Vanilla standing on a bed of dry autumn leaves in gold, ochre and rust, whole vanilla pods laid across the foreground in raked warm sunlight
Tobacco Vanilla photographed in a warm amber scene of low, fireside light
